title: Great habit tracker, but missing a key feature
body:
I'm a huge fan of this habit tracker app. It's been incredibly helpful in keeping me motivated and consistent with my daily routines. The app's design and features make it easy to track progress and build streaks.

While the app is nearly perfect, there's one area for improvement: the ability to skip days. Sometimes, due to travel or unforeseen circumstances, it's impossible to maintain a streak. In these situations, having the option to skip a day without resetting the streak would be a valuable addition. This would help users stay on track without feeling discouraged.
